verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Jira exposes a REST API that developers (including community members) use to build scripts and integrations, and 'Rich APIs' is claimed on the marketing page, but there is no evidence of an official language SDK (Python/JS/Java client libraries) or published API spec — probes for openapi/llms.txt both 404. Missing for 10: dedicated SDK documentation/repos, published OpenAPI spec, and first-party language client libraries.
